info.name: HELOC Inquiries Encryption Payment History V2 API
Download the record of payments for owned loans by asset type and report date

params.name: assetType
params.description: Asset type to query assets for. Must provide originatorId if using

params.name: originatorId
params.description: Originator id to query assets for. Must provide assetType if using assetType query param

params.name: assetGroup
params.description: Name of asset group to filter assets with

params.name: reportDate
params.description: Cutoff date of requested payment history

params.name: ownsPayments
params.description: Only show payments received during ownership of loan

items.docs: Download the record of payments for owned loans by asset type and report date
